name: Face-swap autoencoder
summary: A pair of networks that learn two faces and then draw one face with the pose and expression of the other, frame by frame.
how: Find and crop the face in each frame, and mark its landmark points.
Train one encoder and two decoders on many images of the two faces.
Decode the pose of face A with the decoder of face B.
Blend the new face patch into the frame with a feathered mask of 8px to 24px.
Mark the result as synthetic in any public use.

origin.note: A user of that name posts the first face-swap clips and then shares the method as code; the name deepfake comes from this user name.

adoptions.via: Open tools and phone apps put the method in many hands; detection overlays and labels appear next to the clips.
